newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-FORMER GERMAN DAVIS CUP HERO STEEB TO RETIRE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-FORMER GERMAN DAVIS CUP HERO STEEB TO RETIRE.

text.p: Germany's former Davis Cup hero Carl-Uwe Steeb is to retire from professional tennis.
The 29-year-old Steeb, who has struggled with injuries in the last few years, has been given a wild card to finish his professional career at next week's Stuttgart Open, organisers said on Tuesday.

Steeb's finest hour came in Germany's 1988 Davis Cup final against Sweden in Gothenburg when he upset Mats Wilander in a dramatic five-hour five-setter. The victory set the Germans on the way to their first ever triumph in the competition.
Steeb also played when the Germans successfully defended the title the following year, beating Sweden again in the final in Stuttgart.
